ev.q: A total of 2,407 (98.1%) of referred travelers required active monitoring
During October 25, 2014–April 30, 2015, CDC referred 2,452 travelers to DOHMH for active monitoring.
A total of 2,407 (98.1%) of referred travelers required active monitoring
556 of 796 (69.8%) travelers compared with 1,582 of 1,611 (98.2%) travelers
Approximately 98% of monitored travelers reported no fever or symptoms.
Among the 2,299 (94%) travelers reached for monitoring, 785 (34.1%) left NYC
556 of 796 (69.8%) travelers compared with 1,582 of 1,611 (98.2%) travelers during January 1, 2015–April 30, 2015 (p<0.01)
This report describes the operational structure of the NYC Department of Health and Mental Hygiene’s (DOHMH) active monitoring program
Successful collection of monitoring data for travelers requiring active monitoring improved over time.
